As a hands-on DevOps lead engineer, you will own release engineering end-to-end—from Git-based source control through Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and production deployments—partnering across development and business teams to deliver secure, reliable releases with urgency and accountability. You’re a self-starter and team player who thrives in dynamic environments, strengthens deployment automation and quality gates, and consistently delivers high-quality, business-critical technology solutions. Standardize reviews and quality gates to protect trunk stability and reduce release risk. Development & Automation Automate build, validation, and release tasks using VS Code, scripting, and Salesforce tooling (e.g., SFDX). Build, maintain, and optimize Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines (validation, packaging, deployment, and rollback). Reduce cycle time and defects through repeatable, automated deployment processes. Salesforce Administration Own sandbox strategy (refreshes, seeding, access) and ensure environment readiness for release. Manage Salesforce metadata/configuration changes and deployment packages across environments. Enforce Salesforce security model and platform best practices. Coordinate release calendars, approvals, and cutovers with cross-functional stakeholders. Troubleshoot deployment failures, resolve dependencies/merge conflicts, and provide post-release production support. Collaboration & Leadership Partner with architects, developers, QA, and business teams to align delivery plans and remove blockers. Coach and mentor admins/developers on DevOps, source control, and release practices. Evaluate and recommend DevOps tools and practices, driving continuous improvements in CI/CD and release processes (reliability, deployment frequency, and auditability). Minimum Qualifications What you will have Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related STEM field. 9+ years hands-on Salesforce administration and environment management experience (security model, metadata/configuration, sandbox strategy/refreshes, deployment processes) 9+ years leading Salesforce DevOps and release management (release planning, deployments, post-release support, and continuous improvement). 8+ years managing Salesforce metadata/code in Git (branching, pull requests, merges). 9+ years implementing CI/CD automation using Azure DevOps pipelines, scripting, and developer tooling (e.g., VS Code, Shell). 9+ years collaborating with architects, developers, QA, and customer-facing teams to manage dependencies, resolve merge conflicts, and deliver releases. Experience with DevOps/release tooling such as Copado, Jenkins, Gearset, Bitbucket, SourceTree, SFDX, and ANT Migration Tool. full_description: Job Description About Persistent We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026. About Position: We are seeking an experienced IBM FTM Technical Lead to support large-scale payments modernization and cloud transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM), enterprise payment processing systems, and OpenShift containerization technologies. This role involves designing, implementing, and supporting mission-critical payment solutions while driving application modernization, cloud-native adoption, and containerization of legacy platforms. You will work closely with architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance transaction processing solutions. Role: IBM FTM Developer Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 10 to 20 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Design, implement, and support IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) solutions across enterprise payment platforms. Configure and manage payment processing workflows for ACH, Check Processing, RTP, Zelle, and related payment services. Develop and maintain FTM components including Map Designer, Transaction Editor, Event Framework, and Message Broker integrations. Interface FTM with upstream and downstream systems including SWIFT, ACH, RTGS, and Core Banking platforms. Analyze and troubleshoot payment transaction processing issues and performance bottlenecks. Support payment modernization initiatives and migration programs. Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, and application teams to define business workflows and integration patterns. Ensure compliance with industry standards, payment regulations, and messaging protocols. Lead containerization initiatives for IBM FTM applications using OpenShift and Docker technologies. Design and implement cloud-native deployment architectures for payments applications. Develop and maintain OpenShift Operators using Ansible and Golang. Migrate applications from WebSphere Application Server to Liberty Profile (WLP). Modernize integration platforms by replacing IBM Integration Bus (IIB) with App Connect Enterprise (ACE). Optimize deployment strategies focusing on performance, scalability, high availability, backup, recovery, and regulatory compliance. Validate containerized deployments across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments. Implement GitOps and DevOps best practices for deployment automation and environment management. Support multi-cluster OpenShift environments and service mesh implementations. Expertise You'll Bring: 10-20 years of overall IT experience with strong expertise in enterprise payments and transaction processing systems. Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience with IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) implementations, upgrades, and support. Deep understanding of payment processing systems including ACH, RTP, Check Processing, SWIFT, and Real-Time Payments. Strong experience with IBM FTM components including Map Designer, Transaction Editor, Event Framework, and payment workflows. Expertise in OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise container orchestration platforms. Hands-on experience developing and managing OpenShift Operators and custom automation frameworks. Strong experience with IBM Integration Bus (IIB), App Connect Enterprise (ACE), WebSphere MQ, and DB2. Solid understanding of ISO 20022 standards and SWIFT MT/MX messaging formats. Strong programming experience in Java, XML, REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, and Shell Scripting. Experience implementing GitOps methodologies using ArgoCD and CI/CD automation pipelines. Familiarity with Istio Service Mesh, multi-cluster deployments, Operators, and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs). Experience supporting high-availability, mission-critical production systems within regulated financial environments. Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning, and root-cause analysis skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership capabilities.
